library: preserve native checkbox checked/disabled/form semantics and browser activation
apply the native indeterminate DOM property when the public indeterminate state requests it
consumer: provide an accessible label/name and application meaning for checked/unchecked/mixed state
provide grouping/fieldset semantics when application context requires them

notes: Indeterminate is a visual/semantic DOM property and does not replace native checked/form behavior.
Mapping status documents the contract; existing-pending AT evidence is not a conformance claim.
